One of my agents smuggles military secrets woven into the silk itself. Recently, she has reported a power struggle emerging in Rak-Ahat... and even more recently, she has reported nothing at all.

Meet with her and ensure no more delays.

passages.title: Subterfuge in Silk
passages.text:
I see our mutual "friend" got my message and sent you to aid.

Our production schedule is shot as our management struggles to assert itself.

I propose this chaos is fertile ground for the ambitious.

passages.title: That's All
passages.text:
It will be interesting to see how all this unfolds... but knowing the Weaver, I'm sure she has some strings to pull to make it go her way.

This is the secret I was trying to pass to her when things started heating up. Why don't you deliver it to her, as a sign of a job well done?

I'm sure she'll be pleased to know that she continues to have a set of eyes in Rak-Ahat.

passages.title: That's All
passages.text:
Aha, I admit I hadn't expected to receive this.

<The Weaver runs her pedipalps over the secret-woven silk, delighted.>

Very interesting. I will have to keep this in mind.

passages.title: Orientation: Gundargaz
passages.text:
Our new kobold friends have been moving into Gundargaz. They've also been gathering odds and ends from around the Ringing Deeps.

You should check in with the Quartermaster! Go have a look at what they've collected. Then we can talk about what we're doing next. 

I heard Anduin's around here somewhere. I suspect he has some plans for Hallowfall. We need all the allies we can get against the nerubians.

passages.title: Orientation: Gundargaz
passages.text: New allies are always appreciated.

passages.title: Orientation: Gundargaz
passages.text: It's good to make new friends. In the days ahead, we'll need all the help we can get.

passages.title: The Flame Within
passages.text:
When sparked, a tinderbox creates a flame that embodies the essence of its bearer's life journey. It is a reflection of your strength and inner spirit.

In your travels, you have met many who could help us fashion a tinderbox capable of igniting a flame befitting your formidable spirit.

Seek the assistance of Speaker Kuldas in Gundargaz. The earthen's knowledge will help create a more powerful tinderbox.

passages.title: The Flame Within
passages.text: You were correct to seek my assistance. As a machine speaker there are few problems I cannot solve.

passages.title: Desperately Seeking Skorthuz
passages.text:
Eh? Who are you? Oh that's right, I heard that there were new folk about.

Say, are you heading north? If so, keep an eye out for my friend, Skorthuz, will you? The laggard was due back an hour ago but is nowhere to be seen. I heard he was heading towards the Chittering Den for some awful reason. 

If you see him, tell him to hurry up and get back here or I'm drinking alone!

passages.title: Desperately Seeking Skorthuz
passages.text: Who are you? Oh, Hrandaz sent you? Is it that time already?

passages.title: Targeted Recon
passages.text:
If you've spent much time in Hallowfall, no doubt by now you've run across the foul magic of the kobyss. Reports that their illusions have been evolving are fiercely debated within the Arathi Army.

Your outside perspective is just what I'm looking for. Venture to the Sunless Strand, slay a few of their illusory assassins, and then report your findings. You'll likely find them hiding in the shadows.

passages.title: Targeted Recon
passages.text:
Their illusory projections of Arathi civilians sound convincing as ever. I struggle to understand how such vicious and undiplomatic creatures can emulate Arathi mannerisms so well.

Nonetheless, this is all in line with our current understanding of the kobyss. Your report shall be put to good use. Thank you, outsider.

passages.title: Return to Moira
passages.text:
Speaker Brinthe's impulsiveness is getting the better of her. 

You'd best return to your comrades and let them know of her intentions!

passages.title: Return to Moira
passages.text: <name>! You're back. Let us end this charade.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text:
For the first time in our history, the outside world is ours to explore and experience.

An off-island faction known as the Alliance came to the aid of our kin. Valiant and wise, the stalwart Alliance has extended an open hand to our people.

Will you be among the first to accept and visit their lands, learn their histories and walk amongst their people?

If that path calls to you, then I hope you'll return to share those experiences and show the earthen what the world has to offer.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text:
Well, here we are! Another <race> from... Khaz Algar, is it?

A couple of Wildhammers sent word that some of your people might be coming to visit.

Well, make yourself at home here in town. The Alliance welcomes all of its new friends with open arms. 

Welcome to Stormwind!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind, <race>. I invite you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who appreciates fine stonework! We have many impressive stone buildings and walls.

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of yours is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay, <name>!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Greetings, <name>.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind. Acclimate yourself and learn all you can.

Our experiences will be invaluable to the Archives back in Dornogal.

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
For the first time in our history, the outside world is ours to explore and experience.

An off-island faction known as the Horde came to the aid of our kin. Spiritual and mighty, the honorable Horde has opened their hand to our people.

Will you be among the first to go where no earthen has ever gone? To walk their lands, hear their songs and learn from their people?

If that path calls to you, then I hope you'll return to share those experiences and show the earthen what the world has to offer.

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
What's this then? An... <race>? I heard we might be seeing some of your people here.

Well, make yourself at home if you can. 

We have plenty of rocks in this sweltering place, so I guess if that's your thing...you'll do just fine.

Just...don't eat the rocks. Do you even eat rocks?

Either way, welcome to Orgrimmar.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, <race>.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Greetings, <name>.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Orgrimmar. Acclimate yourself and learn all you can.

Our experiences will be invaluable to the Archives back in Dornogal.

passages.title: Unfulfilled Requests
passages.text:
I have heard the citizens of the Silken Ward are having trouble with a group of Ascended called the Pale Weavelashers.

The new ward is supposed to be a fresh start for citizens of the capital, at least that is the way the Queen tells it. In actuality it is a way for her to tighten her grip on those she distrust. 

Meet with my assistant Sum'latha. I sent her there ahead of time to gather information. She can fill you in on any details.

passages.title: Unfulfilled Requests
passages.text: You must be the help the Vizier sent. Welcome to the Silken Ward.

passages.title: Flight Training 102
passages.text:
Dunnae think I had nae noticed those rooks spittin' lightnin'. Sure beats tossin' hammers. But it won't mean nothin' if the Stormriders can't hit what they're fightin'.

Let's test their aim. Got some gnomish contraptions here that'll project easy targets for practice. Take Shraubendre back out there an' show them how it's done!

passages.title: Flight Training 102
passages.text: Flyin' takes a firm hand. An' boy do these earthen have that!

passages.title: Flight Training 102
passages.text: Now, that's the stuff! Did a real number on those projectors. But what we really need is a movin' target.

passages.title: Flight Training 103
passages.text:
These recruits seem tae be up for a challenge. Let's find them somethin' with a little bite!

I saw a poor giant just off shore bein' pestered by a swarm of flying devils. Let's see if these rooks can shoot the wings off 'em an' provide some relief.

You and Shraubendre are settin' a good example for the rest. Keep it up!

passages.title: Flight Training 103
passages.text: The training went well, did it? I'm sorry I wasn't there for it. There was just something I had to do.

passages.title: Dhar Oztan
passages.text:
I love the stormrooks. Taking care of them was my directive, so they're all I've ever known. But even so, there are questions about them that even I don't have answers to.

Baelgrim--Stormward Baelgrim--he was the expert. I'd pester him about them at every opportunity. And he shared what he could.

He told me once about summoning rooks at Dhar Oztan. It's an old Stormrider outpost that predates the Stormperch. If you want to know more about stormrooks, that's where we need to go.

passages.title: Dhar Oztan
passages.text: So Baelgrim is gone. And now others have come. You mean to summon more rooks, don't you?

passages.title: Home to Roost
passages.text:
You've already done us a great service here, <name>. We will carry on by the example you have set.

You should return to Dhar Oztan and see to these new Stormriders you've recruited. They will undoubtedly benefit from the same diligence you have shown here.

And, you can get away from these two and their posturing. I envy you, <name>...

passages.title: Home to Roost
passages.text:
It's good to have you back. Did all go well with the ground forces?

We're just about ready to start flight training here.

passages.title: The War Within
passages.text:
People are experiencing visions of a "Radiant Song" all across Azeroth. We have reason to believe it's a warning of some kind.

Meet me in Silithus. Perhaps Azeroth's Speaker can shed some light on what this warning might mean.

passages.title: The War Within
passages.text: These visions grow stronger by the day.

passages.title: The War Within
passages.text: We're all here. Good. Let's find out what the Radiant Song is trying to tell us.

passages.title: To Arathi's End
passages.text:
We will regroup on the outskirts of Arathi's End to the east.

Their forces are nearly ready and there isn't much time, <name>.

passages.title: To Arathi's End
passages.text:
You made it. Now let's see if we can make a dent in these nerubians and save Hallowfall.

I can already taste the rewards!

passages.title: Slept Like a Rock
passages.text: Champion, Da's awake. Please return to Dalaran.

passages.title: Slept Like a Rock
passages.text: Welcome back Champion.

passages.title: The Light's Call
passages.text:
Attention, residents of Hallowfall!

Urgent assistance is needed to reclaim the shadowed outskirts.

As darkness grips countless family farms, your aid is needed to ignite the sacred flame and restore safety to our lands.

passages.title: The Light's Call
passages.text: We are glad to have your support. Anything you can do to help re-ignite these keyflames will help!

passages.title: Tale of Tails
passages.text:
The newborn lynx have wandered off again!

Those rascally cats are always up to mischief, darting off without a care. With Peevish missing and only Vesper and I to hold this position, your assistance would be a boon!

I reckon those pesky felines are somewhere nearby. See if you can bring them back.

I would use a light and search the cave, the spider-infested area to the south, and the coast to the north.

passages.title: Tale of Tails
passages.text: Have you found all the cats?

passages.title: Tale of Tails
passages.text:
If these cat could talk they'd have quite the story to tell!

It looks as if one has taken a liking to you. I think you might have a new friend.

passages.title: The Better Part of Valorstones
passages.text:
Dornogal! A fascinating new place to everyone--not just the dracthyr!

And fascinating new places have fascinating new reagents to find and study. Like Valorstones!

I've seen similar objects all over Azeroth used to upgrade weapons and armor. I hypothesize these will work the same way.

Help my research by bringing me any Valorstones you collect. I'll upgrade a piece of your gear in return!

passages.title: The Better Part of Valorstones
passages.text: There's no need to hurry. But if you wouldn't mind hurrying anyway...

passages.title: The Better Part of Valorstones
passages.text: My friend! You are truly a supportive breeze in flight. Please take these tokens of thanks.

passages.title: The Harbinger of Crests
passages.text:
Your help is always appreciated, and now you know you can easily upgrade lower-level gear right here.

Valorstones can only go so far, as I'm sure you know. You need these... Harbinger Crests to upgrade powerful adventuring gear. Much like Valorstones, these Crests are rewarded through many different activities. Harbinger Crests have four tiers, and more dangerous tasks reward you with higher-tier crests.

Bring me fifteen Weathered Harbinger Crests, and we can help you upgrade some gear further.

passages.title: The Harbinger of Crests
passages.text: If you're having a hard time finding Weathered Harbinger Crests, you can search for hidden treasures around Khaz Algar or those underground areas I've heard about. There's no shortage of those treasures!

passages.title: The Harbinger of Crests
passages.text: This is wonderful. I'm excited for you to grow in power! And to advance my research, of course. But yes, your power growth!

passages.title: Transmutation Station
passages.text:
My friend, these Crests are magnificent. It seems they can be transformed into different levels of Crest!

If you find yourself with a multitude of a lower-strength crest, you can upgrade it for a more powerful one! I think. I'm still working on that. I'll let you know when I figure it out. But we can transmute to weaker Crests right now!

See for yourself. Here's a few Carved Harbinger Crests. Speak to me and I can transform them into Weathered Harbinger Crests, all without excess energy or entropy!

passages.title: Transmutation Station
passages.text: If you lose those Carved Harbinger Crests, you can find more from powerful creatures around Khaz Algar. I've heard there's quite a variety of them!

passages.title: Transmutation Station
passages.text:
See? Isn't it remarkable?

I will let you know soon as I figure out how to turn Weathered Harbinger Crests into Carved Harbinger Crests. If my experience with other Crests is any guide, it will takes more of the Weathered Harbinger Crests to go that direction. But weakening Crests? That's easy!

passages.title: Embassies and Envoys
passages.text:
We sailed for what seemed like an eternity. I must admit there were times when I worried we would arrive too late.

But seeing all of you, united and strong, has rekindled my hope.

Before we begin planning, we must set up a base of operations here in Dornogal.

passages.title: Embassies and Envoys
passages.text:
Ye mean tae tell me ye have been an interior decorator this whole time an ye have been holdin' out on me?

Well done, <name>.

Ye are rearrangin' me chambers when we get home, ye are.

passages.title: Does Anyone Like Wasps?
passages.text:
We haven't been able to gather resources from this area due to hornets moving in. 

We just haven't been able to spare the resources from the wall to deal with them. If you can, we'd all appreciate it.

passages.title: Does Anyone Like Wasps?
passages.text: Damn those hornets. Wasps were bad enough when they were the size of my finger.

passages.title: Does Anyone Like Wasps?
passages.text:
Thanks, <name>. 

I hate those things. Seriously, who thought it was a good idea to have wasps the size of a lynx.

passages.title: A Home Cooked Meal
passages.text:
Home-cooked stew. There is nothing like it in the world. 

I grant you, it might not be as tasty as the stew from the Empires Edge Inn. But it was cooked by family. That's what makes it great.

Join us. You have more than earned the right.

passages.title: A Home Cooked Meal
passages.text: It's been such a long time since I had a meal with the entire family.

passages.title: A Home Cooked Meal
passages.text:
Ah, I needed this.

You are welcome to join us anytime, <name>.

passages.title: Check on the Compiler
passages.text: That's everything up here. Would you check on Brennok? Recitations can be stressful, I'm sure he'd appreciate the help.

passages.title: Check on the Compiler
passages.text: I was just about to look for you.

passages.title: For The Love of Gems
passages.text:
Before Dalaran crashed, I was a preeminent expert on gems. But I lost it all--gems, books, scrolls--like everyone else. 

Imagine my surprise when I learned of a creature named Basalteous that possesses knowledge of gems stretching back before the Sundering. 

I want that knowledge. I will do anything for it.

But the rock-skinned yokels here won't tell me any more about Basalteous. Can you get the earthen to talk?

passages.title: For The Love of Gems
passages.text: Were you able to talk to them? Do you have any information?

passages.title: For The Love of Gems
passages.text: You got them to talk to you? Amazing! That is more information than I thought they had.

passages.title: Worldsoul: World Quests
passages.text:
There so much to be done and so little time to do it!

Brinthe and I have been gathering word of the people that need the most aid throughout all of Khaz Algar. There's too many to count!

Go out and help them. With your aid, will can bring all our people closer together... so we may all grow stronger.

passages.title: Worldsoul: World Quests
passages.text:
Strange, these notes that come from Azj-kahet. I am.. hesitant to send any aid to the nerubians. Not after what they've done to my people.

But between your reports and those from our scouts... perhaps we can use their... disagreements to our advantage. And perhaps some are truly in need of aid. Of kindness. 

I do not want my eyes to be clouded by hate. And yet... 

<Faerin sighs.> 

Who knows. All I do know I won't regret a kindness.

passages.title: Worldsoul: World Quests
passages.text: Ah! I've had so many scouts and letters already! You've done so well. I hope you know you are appreciated.

passages.title: Precious Gems
passages.text:
So, all they gave us was a location and a garbled riddle...

But I guess we know where to start.

I can picture it now. Once I have Basalteous's knowledge, I will have nobles and merchants lining up outside my house. No, my mansion! 

The earthen did say southwest, right? I will find the cave and meet you there. Quickly now!

passages.title: Precious Gems
passages.text:
Look at the walls of this cave. Look at all these gems! I can't believe it. The story must be real! 

I am going to be so, so rich. And influential. And powerful.

I need to sit down for a moment and catch my breath.

passages.title: What We Do For Gems
passages.text:
According to the earthen, we have to lure the spirit. Or disturb it. Or something.

The four standing stones they mentioned have depleted elemental cores laying around them. There are igneous elementals outside and on the beach to the north. Are you thinking what I'm thinking? 

Could you get me elemental cores? Maybe just a few? We're so close, so we might as well try...

passages.title: What We Do For Gems
passages.text: Do you have the cores?

passages.title: What We Do For Gems
passages.text:
Four cores for four standing stones. 

I am ready when you are.

passages.title: Gems Are Forever
passages.text:
I am so close, I can feel it in my bones.

Place the cores next to each standing stone. It is time to summon Basalteous.

passages.title: Gems Are Forever
passages.text: This is it. I can feel it.

passages.title: Gems Are Forever
passages.text:
That was almost effortless! For me, at least. 

Can you imagine what I can do with this knowledge? Can you imagine my name spoken in Stormwind? Gilneas? Maybe even Orgrimmar! 

I will be able to do and achieve everything I wanted. Everyone will finally look up to me. I will have all the gold for all I can find and create!

passages.title: A Helping Farmhand
passages.text:
Greetings, adventurer, name's Orren. We've got a whole mess of Jawcrawlers that came up from underground attacking the crops. Something a <class> like yourself could really help out with!

Hunger is never far away in Hallowfall, so saving these crops is my priority.

But if you'd be willing to drive them off for me, I'll be able to focus on my long-term plan to feed people more effectively.

Meet me over by the shed! And bring any food that's not too chewed up.

passages.title: A Helping Farmhand
passages.text: This'll keep our crops safe in the future. And perhaps the leftovers can go... in a stew.

passages.title: A Helping Farmhand
passages.text:
Good work, <name>, that looks... edible. And when you're on the wall, worried about nerubians killing you, I doubt anyone will mind. 

I was able to get a lot of ELIZA's decision sprockets properly aligned while you were doing that, so thanks!

passages.title: Regularly Scheduled Maintenance
passages.text:
I've got another problem that's a bit more... personal, adventurer.

My girlfriend, Aemyra, is a Lamplighter. I thought she'd be back from her last mission, to Velhan's Claim, by now.

Could you go make sure she's okay, and deliver this message? I'm worried to the point of distraction.

Maybe you could also pick some of her favorite flowers, up that hill? 

I'd go myself, but if I can get ELIZA working right, it would do so much to feed people in Hallowfall. And give me more time to spend with Aemyra, too!

passages.title: Regularly Scheduled Maintenance
passages.text: These are from Orren? I think they go well together, even though they're so different.

passages.title: Regularly Scheduled Maintenance
passages.text:
Wow, that's really sweet of him. I'll be here for a while, dealing with the kobyss, but I should send something back. 

So he knows I'm safe, and that I can't wait to see him.

passages.title: The Sword is Mightier
passages.text:
I had told Orren I'd be back by now, but Velhan's Claim has larger problems than I expected. The people here need my help against the kobyss.

adventurer, I've always been better with a sword than a pen. Strong feelings and being far apart makes it even harder. 

I'm more at home protecting the vulnerable than being vulnerable. 

Perhaps I could tell you what I want to get across and you could write it for me?

passages.title: The Sword is Mightier
passages.text: Did you find Aemyra? Is she alright?

passages.title: The Sword is Mightier
passages.text: I'm really glad to hear she's okay! But I have a huge problem now.

passages.title: Job Killing Robot Or...
passages.text:
I shouldn't have set ELIZA to simply gather as much food as she could. She was working, but when a wagon came by, full of food for Mereldar, she started chasing it! And she wouldn't let me access her decision sprockets or tensor springs!

I kept trying, but ELIZA wouldn't stop. Eventually, she outran me. adventurer, I need you to stop her before someone gets killed.

passages.title: Job Killing Robot Or...
passages.text: Were you able to stop ELIZA?

passages.title: Job Killing Robot Or...
passages.text:
ELIZA didn't work like I expected. But Aemyra believes I'll get it right... I'm going to keep trying. 

And when I do, lack of food won't be a threat to the Arathi--and lack of time won't keep me from Aemyra!

passages.title: Worldsoul: Snuffling
passages.text:
I've wanted to be able to explore beyond Hallowfall's caves for so long now. Of course, I hardly have time, but when I do... there's such surprises everywhere!

Treasures, friends in need, foes great and small... All so wonderful. 

I'll just have to live vicariously through you. Deeds need doing! Go out and seek the surprises in every nook and cranny. I'm certain you will find things that need doing!

passages.title: Worldsoul: Snuffling
passages.text: Oh, what have you found?! Tell me everything.

passages.title: Worldsoul: Snuffling
passages.text: Our world is a wonderful place. Thank you for protecting it.

passages.title: Worldsoul: Cinderbrew Meadery
passages.text:
Ah, Cinderbrew. It really is as stout and fiery a brew as they claim.

I can't help but imagine it's how Beledar would taste...

The earthen love it! And it's an important part of their heritage. And so we can't let their meadery fall into the wrong hands.

But... watch out for the cinderbees. I hear their stingers are... well, I won't scare you with that. But I am glad I'm leaving this to you.

passages.title: Worldsoul: Cinderbrew Meadery
passages.text:
Did you get stung by any bees? Did you feel the burn? Maybe you're allergic.

<Faerin chuckles.>

What? That wasn't a funny enough joke? Then you do better!

passages.title: Worldsoul: Cinderbrew Meadery
passages.text:
Ah, Cinderbrew. It really is as stout and fiery a brew as they claim.

I can't help but imagine it's how Beledar would taste...

The earthen love it! And it's an important part of their heritage. And so we can't let their meadery fall into the wrong hands.

But... watch out for the cinderbees. I hear their stingers are... well, I won't scare you with that. But I am glad I'm leaving this to you.

passages.title: Worldsoul: Cinderbrew Meadery
passages.text:
Did you get stung by any bees? Did you feel the burn? Maybe you're allergic.

<Faerin chuckles.>

What? That wasn't a funny enough joke? Then you do better!

passages.title: Worldsoul: Awakening Machine
passages.text:
The earthen tell me of this "Awakening Machine" that is part of their life cycle.

It imbues them with energy, once a gift of the titans but now from the Worldsoul.

<Faerin smiles faintly and nods knowingly.>

They hold it in high reverence--as we do Beledar. 

I will fight to defend it with the same fervor as I would defend our own star! 

Aid me, <name>. We can't let them down.

passages.title: Worldsoul: Awakening Machine
passages.text: Wonderful! I know our earthen allies appreciate your aid.

passages.title: Radiant Echoes
passages.text:
<A missive finds its way to you.>

adventurer, please come to Dalaran at once. Strange phenomena are appearing all across Azeroth. We believe they may be connected to the Radiant Song. I'd like you to investigate.

passages.title: Radiant Echoes
passages.text: Thank you for answering my summons.

passages.title: Memories of Adventures Past
passages.text:
It seems that Azeroth has grown... agitated? Something must have happened when Magni tried to commune with her. 

Past events have now come to life once more. I believe they're Azeroth's memories.

Memories they may be, these Radiant Echoes are all too real and could cause serious danger if left unattended. I ask that you investigate one of them and help however you can.

passages.title: Memories of Adventures Past
passages.text: Radiant Echoes and Radiant Visions, all appearing at once. What could Azeroth be trying to tell us? Or perhaps it's just... instinct.

passages.title: Memories of Adventures Past
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. Keep assisting with these Radiant Echoes and see if you can find a common thread. They must be connected somehow.

passages.title: The Brothers Braunpyke
passages.text:
Baron Braunpyke and his brother have been working on removing our lingering kobyss problem from near the Veneration Grounds.

Meet with them there and see what help you can offer.

passages.title: The Brothers Braunpyke
passages.text: I hope you're here to get your hands dirty!

passages.title: Broken Masquerade
passages.text:
I cannot remember how I arrived at this swamp, but it was great luck that I did. As I wandered, I spotted Lady Katrana Prestor entering a strange toothy cave. Now, what would a noblewoman be doing in such a ghoulish place?

Following her closely, I found a great clutch of black dragon eggs within the lair. Such evidence is clear. Katrana is Lady Onyxia! 

I beg of you, aid me in defeating this vile dragon once and for all.

passages.title: Broken Masquerade
passages.text: If only Varian were here. Surely he'd have no issue slaying her.

passages.title: Broken Masquerade
passages.text:
Is it true? She finally rests?

Hers was an unwavering ambition. It's good that we stopped her when we did. I cannot imagine the tragedies that would have followed if she was allowed to continue her ploys and schemes.

passages.title: Birdman of the Three Shields
passages.text:
Are you here to watch the mosswools? No? 

That's too bad. I find the elemental creatures on our isle fascinating. I'm not the only one. 

An old friend of mine named Olbarig resides out on the Three Shields. He studies the wild cloudrooks there.

But come to think of it, I haven't heard from him in awhile. Maybe someone should check on him. Hm. Would you mind?

passages.title: Birdman of the Three Shields
passages.text:
Harmot sent you to check on me? 

Huh. Well, I didn't know that sack of charcoal cared.

But he does have an innate sense of when elementals are in turmoil. Maybe he knew something was brewing out here.

Harmot's timing is good, outlander. And your aid would be most welcome.

passages.title: Only Darkness
passages.text: Long have I waited for this day, hero. Are you and your allies prepared to bring the Lich King to justice? We charge on your command!

passages.title: Only Darkness
passages.text: We battle for the fate of Azeroth. For the light of dawn!

passages.title: Only Darkness
passages.text:
So, at last it is done.

May the people of Azeroth remember our deeds here forevermore. May the sacrifices of so many burn in their hearts eternally. May they never fail to risk mortal peril in the face of great evil.

passages.title: Deephaul Ravine
passages.text: We've received reports of troubles in the earthen depths. Explore the Deephaul Ravine and the resources available, then report to Ruffious.

passages.title: Deephaul Ravine
passages.text: You made it through the mines! Splendid!

passages.title: Heritage of the Earthen
passages.text:
The time has come to give back to the Archives. 

All earthen wanderers are invited to share their experiences for the preservation of what has come before and the betterment of those who will come after. 

This knowledge and experience of the wider world of Azeroth is a priceless treasure, and the practice of sharing it is key to our earthen heritage.

passages.title: Heritage of the Earthen
passages.text: Have you uploaded your experiences yet?

passages.title: Heritage of the Earthen
passages.text: We cannot thank you enough for this gift. Your experiences will be invaluable to the <race> still now awakening in the Ringing Deeps. Please accept this and wear it proudly as you continue to travel amongst the peoples of Azeroth and beyond.

passages.title: Attention-Getter
passages.text:
My, adventurer, it seems you have drawn the attention of a particular audience member.

This fan letter was mistakenly included in my fan mail. I'm not surprised. Sorting my copious fan mail must be a difficult chore...

Here, take it. It belongs to you, of course.

I'm sure this is very new for you. I have a few pieces of wisdom for greeting eager fans, if you would like to hear it...

passages.title: Attention-Getter
passages.text:
We must be careful with fans. We must be gentle with their feelings but also discourage unwanted behaviors.

Kind and gracious acknowledgement of their gratitude is key. A simple thank you note in return is optimal. And if you see them here, it is acceptable to nod and wave. We want our audience to be happy, of course.

And, in the event they bring flowers... I can graciously take that burden from you.

passages.title: Ghosts in the Machine
passages.text:
There's a substation directly below us? Perhaps that is where Arbauch went to hide it... Disregard, we must investigate.

With luck, Arbauch may still be here. The entrance should be to the north, near the pool of water from the burst pipe. Please, come with me. He may need our help.

I will explain everything once he is located.

passages.title: Ghosts in the Machine
passages.text: It killed him, and we let it loose. Even his memory gem is gone.

passages.title: Duty of Care
passages.text:
The golem is unstable. I doubt it can travel far. We will track it, but haste failed me once already. Arbauch showed true devotion to the machines--we will follow his example. Repairs must come first.

Machine systems are delicate. We must activate the backup before the failure can cascade. Exterminate any pests you find as well. Even the smallest creature can ruin delicate machinery.

I am damaged. I will send my cogwalker with you to relay instructions.

passages.title: Duty of Care
passages.text: Our primary duty is to mend.

passages.title: Duty of Care
passages.text: The backup systems are operational. Now we may track the golem.

passages.title: All Ore Nothing
passages.text:
Outlander. Your aid is requested. 

The earthen here have said you would be of help. 

Our fellow earthen at the Opalcreg have not reported their quota for the past day. There must be something causing a disruption. 

Would you pay Foreman Alvegar a visit?

passages.title: All Ore Nothing
passages.text:
I'm hiding... lay low. 

Foreman Germira sent you? She must be worried that we haven't sent over our quota.

passages.title: Third Mine Blind
passages.text:
I got cut off from the rest of the crew. We did not expect to be attacked by nerubians. Though I can't imagine the rest quitting.

Our duty is too important to give up just yet. 

Barging right into the mine could cause the nerubians to frenzy and hurt the others. So, I found a third way to get in earlier. Though undetected will still be tough. 

Follow me.

passages.title: Third Mine Blind
passages.text: You made it undetected, good. Time to surprise these Nerubians!

passages.title: Hit Rock Bottom
passages.text:
A long way down to be sure, but I am certain that you can make it. 

If you doubt yourself, I made some parachutes to help you stick the landing. 

Once you get to the bottom of the cave, look for Cenderragg. She's the most senior of the group and probably has the best idea on how to rescue the team.

passages.title: Hit Rock Bottom
passages.text: Who are you and why are you here?

passages.title: Web Beats Rock
passages.text:
So, Foreman Alvegar sent you? That explains it.

The situation is not great. This place is crawling with nerubians and they're showing us no mercy. They forced us to mine and took our hard-earned opals. 

When you disobey, they web you up. 

I was barely able to escape them when they came. The others... Well, that's where you come in.

With you here distracting them, I can go rally the webbed earthen.

passages.title: Web Beats Rock
passages.text: Thank the machine! They're free!

passages.title: Beetlejeweled
passages.text:
To make sure no other earthen gets harmed we're going to have to eliminate their leader. 

You know the saying, rid yourself of the foreman and the whole line collapses. 

Either way, to get to safety we're going to have to go through them.

passages.title: Beetlejeweled
passages.text:
You made it back, I was beginning to think all hope was destroyed. 

Alvegar filled me in with the issue. I'm just glad all our people are safe, and we got the opal too.

A small win, but a win.

passages.title: Gryphons of a Feather
passages.text: Hey there! I notice ye got a stormrook that's lookin' rather unhappy. Let's see what we can do to cheer 'em up.

passages.title: Gryphons of a Feather
passages.text: Kwee wah?

passages.title: Gryphons of a Feather
passages.text: <Squally chirps with delight, hopping around excitedly.>

passages.title: Time Found
passages.text:
Yer back!

If you're up for it, there's more things in the muck to be found. Might have to dig a bit deeper this time.

passages.title: Time Found
passages.text: What'd you find?

passages.title: Time Found
passages.text: Same as before, I'll have you take some of these to see if we can't find their owners.

passages.title: Decommissioning Darkness
passages.text:
Decommissioning a machine is a rare necessity. It must be done with care and regret.

We put much of ourselves into our work. To destroy it is to destroy a part of ourselves. In doing so, we admit our failure to protect the Titans' work. But where stone rebels against stone, we must stand firm.

Imperative: Destroy it. Recover Arbauch's memory gem.

passages.title: Decommissioning Darkness
passages.text: Regret. This should have been my burden.

passages.title: Decommissioning Darkness
passages.text:
There is no joy in the death of a machine, but I express gratitude. I suspect Arbauch would too. 

His decisions were his own, but none can doubt that he devoted his life to the machines. The Titans would be proud.

passages.title: Sturdy Locket
passages.text: Wait... this locket.

passages.title: Wooden Figure
passages.text: Ah, this is cute. Couldn't tell you where it came from - it appears to be made by a hobbyist rather than an artisan. I'll put it up on display though.

passages.title: Calcified Journal
passages.text: Ah! I haven't seen this in years...

passages.title: Something Earthy
passages.text:
Ah, another one of you lot, eh? Well, if you want to eat, you need to help.

Pick me a fresh taro, will you?

passages.title: Something Earthy
passages.text: Have you brought the taro?

passages.title: Something Earthy
passages.text: Oh. Well... you tried.

passages.title: Something Not Ruined
passages.text: Alright, I'll come with you. Show you how to do this properly. If I'm up, we might as well stock up on taro. Can't rely on adventurers to do delicate work, I suppose.

passages.title: Something Not Ruined
passages.text: Is that all of them?

passages.title: Something Not Ruined
passages.text: Much better. This will last for a while. If you want to eat, though, I'll need a little more help.

passages.title: Ivory Tinderbox
passages.text:
A lost item?

This is mine, but I hesitate to say it was lost.

passages.title: Dented Spearhead
passages.text: Ah, I thought I simply misplaced this.

passages.title: Enough Garlic
passages.text:
Normally, this would do. I'm not so picky. But you're a guest. So we'll need some garlic.

I found some growing on a hill not far off. Shouldn't be there. But it is.

Too bad hydras found it, too.

You have weapons and such, right?

passages.title: Enough Garlic
passages.text: You think that's enough?

passages.title: Enough Garlic
passages.text: Ahh, there we go. That is enough garlic.

passages.title: Sous
passages.text: Alright, now help me finish this.

passages.title: Sous
passages.text: Time to cook!

passages.title: Sous
passages.text: Thanks, stranger. It's nice to have some company to pass the time. Good luck on your travels.

passages.title: Filigreed Cleric
passages.text: Well look here. I was wondering where this was.

passages.title: An Opportunity to Relax
passages.text:
Hey, you! Yeah, you'll do. You wanna make some coin? We's tryin' to drum up business at our exclusive resort. Maybe ye heard of it? Opportunity Point Spa and Resort! 

Boss sent me up to Gundargaz to pass out this stack of flyers, but my trike blew a gasket and I'll be stuck here for a bit repairing her. How's about you head up there and pass them out for me? Look for the tired and weary types.

passages.title: An Opportunity to Relax
passages.text:
I shoulda listened to my mechanic. He told me there was no way my trike was gonna make it all the way up here, but my boss has been on me to get more clients. 

Did you pass out those flyers yet?

passages.title: An Opportunity to Relax
passages.text: You're back! How did it go? Should we start preparing for large crowds?

passages.title: To Opportunity Point
passages.text:
Glad that's out of the way. Now my boss can stop breathing down my neck!

I got some repairs to do on my ride, but you should go to Opportunity Point and check it out! I'll even give you a free drink voucher to our fine establishment. 

Go talk to Griz Finglebur and he'll get you sorted.

passages.title: To Opportunity Point
passages.text: Welcome to Opportunity Point! You got a drink ticket, eh? Coming right up!

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: Lily's Locket
passages.text: <This locket must be important to someone. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: Lily's Locket
passages.text:
You found it! That's Lily's locket. She lost it around the time of Aunt Gerta's accident. 

We've been searching everywhere for it.

passages.title: Stone Tracing
passages.text:
Couldn't help overhearing. Not to brag, but goblins are specialists in the field of rampaging robots.

If that golem's as unstable as Danagh says, it'll be leaking all sorts of energy. Take this, run a few scans, and you'll find it. Oh, and be careful. Animals tend to go a little cuckoo when you power this thing on.

No charge--a murderous golem's bad for business. And I kinda feel bad making you work just to find a dead guy.

passages.title: Stone Tracing
passages.text: Curious. It seemed to be wandering along the river. Unimportant, we have its location. We will find it and decommission it.

passages.title: Undoing the Damage
passages.text:
Apologies. Arbauch was not here for repairs--he stole that golem.

Arbauch and I worked alongside it for years in the darkest reaches of the Deeps. The work took its toll on the golem. It became erratic, dangerous even. We planned to decommission it, but when the time came, Arbauch couldn't bear it. He'd become attached. Before it could be destroyed, he took it and fled.

It must be found, but the damage to this substation is catastrophic. With your help, I will attempt repairs.

passages.title: Undoing the Damage
passages.text: A foreman and a substation lost. Blast. I was careless.

passages.title: An Igneous End
passages.text:
When the magma transport pipe failed, our workers rushed down to begin repairs.

The elementals caught us unawares, rising up and attacking with great gouts of lava.

Fortunately, we earthen are made of stern stuff and a little magma is hardly going to be the end of us. Unfortunately, the cooling magma has hardened into stone shells, entombing our repair crews where they stood.

Smash their stony prisons and free my workers!

passages.title: An Igneous End
passages.text: Don't worry about hurting them, just get them free.

passages.title: An Igneous End
passages.text: Thank you, topsider. With our crews returned, we can get back to work.

passages.title: Magmanagement
passages.text:
As if the pipe going down wasn't enough, a horde of magmatic elementals burst out when it failed.

We can't risk sending anyone else down to attempt repairs while the area is overrun, but that magma is vital to powering the whole Deeps.

If you are capable, clear them out so we can get that magma flowing again.

passages.title: Magmanagement
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Magmanagement
passages.text: Commendable job. We could do with a little less excitement in our work.

passages.title: Sampling Steam
passages.text:
The effects of the magmatic buildup are clear to see, but what we still do not understand is the root cause.

In order to determine it, and prevent it in the future, I need samples of the volcanic gases you can see bursting from the ground.

Fresh samples. Very fresh.

You're going to have to stand in them as they erupt in order to gather what I need.

passages.title: Sampling Steam
passages.text: Do you have the samples?

passages.title: Sampling Steam
passages.text: Hopefully these samples will reveal what went wrong. Your assistance is appreciated.

passages.title: Tired of Tripping
passages.text:
All that's between us and the juiciest excavation site I've ever seen is a couple of moles and a leggy deer. Sorry, getting ahead of myself.

See these shredders? State of the art in the field of maiming and killing. And they keep getting stuck in holes!

Listen, I'm as ecologically conscientious as the next goblin, but these moles have got to go. I'm gonna need you to give these hardheads a hard time. And if you see any of my crew, help 'em out, wontcha?

passages.title: Tired of Tripping
passages.text: You deal with 'em yet? I'm not hauling another shredder out of the mud.

passages.title: Tired of Tripping
passages.text: You sure sent 'em scurrying! There's only one teensy thing left between us and all those beautiful resources.

passages.title: A Little Off the Top
passages.text:
Ever seen a deepstrider before? This one sure ain't happy to see us. Made quick work of the shredders that made it past the moles. Real shame, those pilots are gonna have to work overtime to pay off the damages.

Now if someone were to take care of it and bring back something as proof, well, I'm sure there'd be a nice payday.

passages.title: A Little Off the Top
passages.text: What did you do?!

passages.title: A Little Off the Top
passages.text: This is bad, real bad! You'd think killin' something would make it less dangerous. We're getting stomped!

passages.title: Put it Back, Put it Back!
passages.text:
It's going to ruin everything! Who wants to visit a resort with a thirty-foot tall ghost-deer? Ok, no need to panic. It's probably just a little miffed you took its skull.

First, you gotta get rid of some of these slimes. Then, get that skull out of here. The farther the better.

Oh man, they're gonna get ectoplasm in the hot pools!

passages.title: Put it Back, Put it Back!
passages.text: Hurry up, before this whole place is wrecked!

passages.title: Put it Back, Put it Back!
passages.text:
Whew, that was close. This whole thing has really taught me to value the beauty of nature.

<The goblin breaks into laughter.>

Really had you going there, huh? Still, think I'll leave Abyssal Excavation alone for awhile.

passages.title: City of Threads: Splice the Splicer
passages.text:
"Ascension" is no true evolution. It is defilement. It is doom. And Ansurek further etches that doom in stone with each passing day.

If we bring down the Transformatory, then we can potentially rid Azj-Kahet of these abominations for good.

Izo the Grand Splicer is Ansurek's chosen overseer of the Ascension process. Cut that wretch's head from her body, and perhaps these mutations will cease.

passages.title: City of Threads: Splice the Splicer
passages.text: Have you dealt with the Transformatory, <name>?

passages.title: City of Threads: Splice the Splicer
passages.text:
You've dealt a blow that Ansurek will never recover from, <name>.

Take this and be well.

passages.title: Badly Behaved Bot
passages.text:
Go ahead, laugh. I would be as well if I didn't have such pressing business. My bot's foot clipped a nearby rock, spilled me out and then righted herself. Without me in the cockpit! 

I'm grounded while she floats there quite cheerfully. Can you believe it? 

Listen, if you are heading up to Shadowvein Point, will you let Kagfritha know that I'll be late for my shift? I need to wait for this hunk of metal to run out of fuel and dip low enough for me to get back in the driver's seat.

passages.title: Badly Behaved Bot
passages.text: Sinruna got tossed again, did she? I keep telling her she's flying too low. Maybe this'll knock some sense into her.

passages.title: Ara-Kara, the City of Echoes: Harvest's End
passages.text:
You've seen it yourself, haven't you? The "Black Blood," as we call it.

We will not stand idle any longer. Not while Ansurek mutilates, drills, and exsanguinates our precious land for the last, fetid dribbles of the old gods' death rattle. 

Seek out the old city beneath us--Ara-Kara, The City of Echoes. You will receive a handsome bounty should you slay the crony in charge of the excavation. Her people call her Ki'katal, the Harvester.

passages.title: Ara-Kara, the City of Echoes: Harvest's End
passages.text: Have you been to Ara-Kara yet?

passages.title: Ara-Kara, the City of Echoes: Harvest's End
passages.text:
Ki'katal is dead? Excellent.

You have our thanks, <name>. In both praise, and material value.

passages.title: Suspicious Minds
passages.text:
For many years, the only non-Arathi we ever saw in Hallowfall were trying to kill us. Nerubians, shadow creatures, beasts. So, forgive me if I view your sudden arrival with suspicion.

However, my better half would urge me to be more welcoming... and I want to try to be better. For her.

Some of the salamanthers in Rumshackle have been bothering us. Kill them and bring me proof.

passages.title: Suspicious Minds
passages.text:
Others may be satisfied with just your word that you have done what I'd ask. 

I am not.

passages.title: Suspicious Minds
passages.text:
You have helped.

Perhaps she is right, and perhaps I should follow the example set by Dunelle.

Thank you.

passages.title: There's Always Another Secret
passages.text:
After me da' did whatever he did, the titans' machines are back online--even the ones here in Dornogal.

Dagran was havin' enough fun with Brinthe askin' her a thousand questions, but now he's helpin' her sort through the Archive.

An' now he wants your help. He was too excited to tell me why, but he wanted ye to meet him in the Archive.

passages.title: There's Always Another Secret
passages.text:
Fascinating. This is clearly a chamber meant for a Keeper. But for what? 

We need to investigate.

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Lost Shoe
passages.text: <A shoe in the style worn by members of the Hillhelm family. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Lost Shoe
passages.text:
Addysen and I used to tiptoe barefoot through those caves. With light steps, the slumbering fungus would not awake. It wasn't foolproof, and we did lose a lot of shoes escaping from angry Lashrooms.  

This shoe, however, seems to have once belonged to Gerta?

passages.title: Prove One's Mettle
passages.text:
Yes, you helped us out with these pests, but it is not enough. I need more.

One of the areas near our town has been overrun by shadow. If you are truly not being controlled by your... strange background, you would have no problem destroying the source of this danger, would you?

passages.title: Prove One's Mettle
passages.text: If you are truly here to help the Arathi, you would have no problem with what I am asking of you.

passages.title: Prove One's Mettle
passages.text:
I have been following the Church of the Sacred Flame since the moment I was born. Doctrine is hard to set aside.

But I see now that you are here to help. And as long as you use your powers for us, I will reach out a hand of friendship--regardless of where that power came from.

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Clutch of Eggs
passages.text: <A clutch of chicken eggs, they must have come from a nearby farm. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Clutch of Eggs
passages.text:
You stumbled upon this in the nearby caves? We have a few adventurous chickens who likely wandered in there.

Tracking down all the runaways can be a full-time endeavor.

passages.title: For Morale
passages.text:
Please excuse my husband's rudeness. When we signed up for our expedition, we expected to be away from our families for a few years at worst. Instead, we settled here as we guard against--well, against the end, against Renilash. Who knows when our watch will end?

I've been stockpiling a cache of wine from our church vineyards to share with everyone when tensions got high. My hiding place, Rumshackle, has been overrun by creatures. Can you get the wine for me?

passages.title: For Morale
passages.text:
Imagine twenty Arathi huddling under the safety of a single light for ten years. Imagine they're waiting for a chance to let their hair down with a good drink with their comrades.

Now imagine how they'll feel once they hear the wine is gone.

...please hurry.

passages.title: For Morale
passages.text:
Oh, thank the Flame.

You've prevented a small riot from forming. Bless you, bless you, bless you!

passages.title: Where the Wild Things Camp
passages.text:
Some of my people found a few haranir setting up one of their camps to the southwest. They were missing some vital supplies, so my people offered to help out. However, I worry about how they're all getting along over there.

Could you check in on them? Make sure we're being good hosts to the haranir... and that nobody has inadvertently offended anyone. Please.

passages.title: Where the Wild Things Camp
passages.text: You again. Curious.

passages.title: Strange Bats
passages.text:
Hey. Her ladyship has a lead on some really strange bat that was flying around the Wormlands. 

The spies reported it behaving more like a person than a bat. We think we might have a druid out there, but it ain't revealin' itself to the nerubians on purpose.

You have one of those faces that make people hesitate before punching. Head out there and take a look.

passages.title: Strange Bats
passages.text: You! You are just what I need.

passages.title: A Silken Thread
passages.text:
You looking for work or something? <Linny squints her eyes at you.> If you're just hanging around I've heard some whispers from the capital. An associate of the Weaver is looking into some business in the Silken Ward.

The new ward is supposed to be a fresh start for citizens of the capital but the Queen's Pale Weavelashers have been treating it like a military camp. This isn't sittin' well with the populace.

Meet with a nerubian named Sum'latha outside the ward. She can fill you in on the details.

passages.title: A Silken Thread
passages.text: You must be the help our "mutual friend" sent. Welcome to the Silken Ward.

passages.title: Bountiful Beetles
passages.text:
General Anub'azal has great plans in motion for the swarmery, Rak-Ush. He intends to return it to working order, to support his war campaign.

However... I have my reservations about the two he left in charge. 

Kish'nal seems to have a good head on his shoulders, but Vix'aron? Volatile is an understatement. They may require some... prodding.

Seek out Kish'nal at Rak-Ush and follow up on Anub'azal's orders.

passages.title: Bountiful Beetles
passages.text: Ah, so the general has sent out an observer?

passages.title: Preserve and Pretend
passages.text:
Chive dig for history. You help find? 

Got history detector from goblin. Said it finds history underground! You use. Chive dig.

passages.title: Preserve and Pretend
passages.text:
Many thanks, dig-finder. 

Chive know these have no important history... but they will one day.
 
Chive will keep safe until then. Kobolds make new history. 

Then save and protect. Forever.

passages.title: Gearing Up for Trouble
passages.text:
Greetings friend,

The machine is once again in disrepair and requires restoration. 
I am in need of your expertise to successfully perform maintenance.

A reward shall be provided for well-executed assistance.

passages.title: Gearing Up for Trouble
passages.text: Status report?

passages.title: Gearing Up for Trouble
passages.text:
The machine continues in its duties once again.

Thank you again for your assistance.

passages.title: Stormscarred
passages.text:
Take a look around this beautiful town. What do you see? Ranchers 'n' their mosswools. But where is this rancher's flock? In the guts of a beast, they are. Stormscar they call 'im. 

Stormscar, whose howl is as the thunder. Whose bite is lightning. Whose belly is full of my life's work. 

I came here to buy weapons and all we have is ranching equipment. You look strong. Would you put an end to Stormscar's reign in our pastures?

passages.title: Stormscarred
passages.text: Have you done it yet?

passages.title: Stormscarred
passages.text: Thank you, adventurer. My role in this world is to be a rancher. Yours is to slay wolves. We all have our places.

passages.title: The Mage Slayer
passages.text:
I confess I have come here with reason. There is one entity that may be out there still that cannot be allowed its freedom.

A prisoner from the Violet Hold that we begrudgingly know as the Mage Slayer. I had come to request aid from these people, but they are farmers and ranchers. I hope you are better equipped for a challenge.

Seek out this fiend and put an end to its existence.

passages.title: The Mage Slayer
passages.text:
Dalaran may be in ruins, but the Kirin Tor does not grant you release Mage Slayer!

Thank you for your assistance, <name>.

Are you sure you defeated all of it?

passages.title: The Spirebreaker
passages.text:
We are no strangers to nerubian attacks. The Kirin Tor is well equipped to handle such a threat. Dalaran...

Was equipped. I cannot fend off all of this town's foes, but you might be able to. I spotted an ambush near the road on the way here. An all too familiar tactic of an all too familiar foe. Go spring the trap and slay the monster that lurks below.

passages.title: The Spirebreaker
passages.text: Are they safe now?

passages.title: The Spirebreaker
passages.text:
Thank goodness. With your aid, we may be able to make a difference... this time. 

These people deserve safety.

passages.title: Warbands: Warbanding Together
passages.text:
<name>, some adventurers have gotten together to form a warband and could use your help.

Find Blue and her group in Gadgetzan.

passages.title: Warbands: Warbanding Together
passages.text: Thanks for coming, <name>!

passages.title: Warbands: Rift Reader
passages.text:
I bet you're wondering what we're working on, huh? We're going to make our Warband Bank accessible from anywhere!

Rivet's calling it a Warband Bank Distance Inhibitor until I can think of something more fun, but we need a little help to get it over the finish line.

If we're going to make sure we can access our shared stash from multiple locations, we're going to need portals! And we tracked some doozies down out here.

If you could get us some scans of the local anomalies, it'd be a big help!

passages.title: Warbands: Rift Reader
passages.text: Did you find them?

passages.title: Warbands: Rift Reader
passages.text: Now that's some sparkly data!

passages.title: Warbands: Space Ghosts by the Coast
passages.text:
There are an awful lot of half-teleported things wandering around the desert not too far from here. Really, any at all would be a surprising amount, but there are a bunch of them for some reason!

They don't seem particularly nice, but I bet we could learn from their predicament to ensure the Warband Bank Distance Inhibitor doesn't teleport our sweet loot into a tree!

See if you can find anything that might help us figure out what went wrong. It's not like people randomly teleport around, right?

passages.title: Warbands: Space Ghosts by the Coast
passages.text: Any clues?

passages.title: Warbands: Space Ghosts by the Coast
passages.text: Great job, <name>! I'm not sure what that is, but I bet it'll help!

passages.title: Warbands: Twinsposition
passages.text:
We're on a roll! We picked up an even more anomalous anomaly while you were out and tracked it down to just west of town.

We've got a brand-new Transpositional Signal Recombobulatron already set up out there, but I didn't want to start without you. You've been a big help, after all.

All you have to do is dial it in and throw the switch! Easy as pie, which I'm told is very easy.

Rivet says that the odds of something cataclysmic happening are pretty good, so I know nothing bad can happen!

passages.title: Warbands: Twinsposition
passages.text: Throw the switch!

passages.title: Warbands: Twinsposition
passages.text:
Nice job!

Not what I was expecting, but I have to say evil me was rocking that mustache!

passages.title: Warbands: Spacetime is Money
passages.text:
Now that we've got all the transpositional data we could ever hope for, all we need to do is set up a wormhole in a suitable banking establishment and we'll be dropping gear into each other's pockets from the field in no time!

And there just happens to be a bank right here in Gadgetzan!

You can even attune your own portal at the same time so you can access your own Warband Bank from anywhere. It's going to be so convenient!

passages.title: Warbands: Spacetime is Money
passages.text: Did you find the bank?

passages.title: Warbands: Spacetime is Money
passages.text: A few hiccups, but nothing some good old-fashioned teamwork wasn't up to! Go us!

passages.title: A Concerned Friend
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, there you are! Great Kyron was asking after you and your friend Anduin. 

I think they want to talk to you about Faerin. Nothing urgent mind you, she probably just needs some good company. But we're all a bit worried about her.

Check in with Kyron when you have a moment, will you?

passages.title: A Concerned Friend
passages.text: I hope the journey wasn't long.

passages.title: Hallowfall Fishing Derby
passages.text:
Life is always on the edge here, adventurer. Nerubians, kobyss, hunger--there's always something ready to kill you.

So we need to find times to relax, and challenge ourselves at something other than survival. Like fishing.

My dad always spent Saturdays fishing, when I was growing up. He'd say, "Take some time for yourself, or you can't be effective for others." 

So every Saturday, I challenge people to the Hallowfall Fishing Derby. You have one hour to catch trophy fish. See what you can bring me!

passages.title: Hallowfall Fishing Derby
passages.text: Any bites, <name>?

passages.title: Hallowfall Fishing Derby
passages.text: These are some great catches, <name>! I can't wait to see what you catch next week!

passages.title: Hallowfall Fishing Derby
passages.text:
Life is always on the edge here, adventurer. Nerubians, kobyss, hunger--there's always something ready to kill you.

So we need to find times to relax, and challenge ourselves at something other than survival. Like fishing.

My dad always spent Saturdays fishing, when I was growing up. He'd say, "Take some time for yourself, or you can't be effective for others." 

So every Saturday, I challenge people to the Hallowfall Fishing Derby. You have one hour to catch trophy fish. See what you can bring me!

passages.title: Hallowfall Fishing Derby
passages.text: Any bites, <name>?

passages.title: Hallowfall Fishing Derby
passages.text: These are some great catches, <name>! I can't wait to see what you catch next week!

passages.title: Isle of Dorn
passages.text:
Survivors from the attack on Dalaran are beset by nerubians led by Queensguard Zirix.

Lend your aid to protect whomever remains.

passages.title: Isle of Dorn
passages.text: We won't let the nerubians take any more of our people.

passages.title: The Ringing Deeps
passages.text:
Speaker Brinthe has gone to The Ringing Deeps to see how the Machine Speakers have fared while she was away.

She has asked for adventurers to join her at the bottom of the Coreway.

passages.title: The Ringing Deeps
passages.text: Thank you for coming. This is more of a mess than I expected.

passages.title: Hallowfall
passages.text:
Anduin Wrynn hopes to gain the trust and aid of the Arathi in Hallowfall.

He will need help to win over these potential allies.

passages.title: Hallowfall
passages.text: If you've come to ask for aid, I'm afraid you've found us in the midst of our own crisis.

passages.title: Azj-Kahet
passages.text:
An Arathi airship is stranded in Azj-Kahet following a vicious nerubian ambush.

Aid the survivors as they withstand the nerubian assault.

passages.title: Azj-Kahet
passages.text: Just in time, <name>. We were caught off guard, now let's push them back.

passages.title: The Beginning of Something Beautiful
passages.text:
<This seems like it would be of interest to a nerubian alchemist. 

Ascension is their specialty, and this may be key to understanding more about the process.>

passages.title: The Beginning of Something Beautiful
passages.text: Hm? What? Well this is fascinating...

passages.title: Tense Recovery
passages.text:
Things with these strangers are... tense. We do appreciate being allowed to take cover here in their camp. But they only seem to tolerate us at best. We offered to share our supplies, but that offended them, somehow.

My sister is gravely wounded. I can see herbs I could use to help her in that tent over there, but that giant snail is blocking the entrance. I can't get to them.

I asked the guard on the hill for aid, but all he did was glare. I don't know what to do! Perhaps he'll listen to you?

passages.title: Tense Recovery
passages.text: You are not unwelcome, stranger. I am the last.

passages.title: Ancient Respite
passages.text:
This was once a great lake. Over time the roots ruptured its floor, and drained the water away. I have lived here for all of my lifetime and witnessed it all. But now, darker changes have come.

Sometimes changes comes with death. Decay is natural.

But the mites that feed upon my people are not. They spread an odd infestation that makes my bark feel like it crawls from my body.

Destroy these mites, so that I may rest without fear of their mouths upon my sleeping form.

passages.title: Ancient Respite
passages.text: The sound of their gnawing fills me with dread.

passages.title: Ancient Respite
passages.text: It is quiet. Perhaps I will rest, now, with my people.

passages.title: Rings of Memory
passages.text:
I appreciate what you have done. Do not worry--I am not finished yet.

If you please, take this root to those who sent you. They can read the history of my life within the rings of wood therein. My life is one of many in the tapestry, but we are all intertwined. 

These strangers you encountered may be reclusive--secretive even--but they understand this tapestry like no other, and guard it with their lives.

passages.title: Rings of Memory
passages.text: Did you find the ancients?

passages.title: Rings of Memory
passages.text:
Goehi sent this root, yet was still alive...

I understand. His story is safe with us.

passages.title: Open Communications
passages.text:
You understand that others lead lives different to your own. Our ways restrict us. Our traditions are not for the ears of strangers. I have only spoken to you at all due to Orweyna's word. But I can feel On'hiea's disapproval from here.

It is uncomfortable to have mysteries at times. It is why so many fear the dark. It is unknown.

I know I must seem cryptic. But our ways do not mean we are offended by the Arathi. They are creating tension where it does not exist for us.

passages.title: Open Communications
passages.text: I can't leave my sister like this.

passages.title: Open Communications
passages.text:
I can't believe this was just a simple misunderstanding. I shouldn't have made assumptions. 

Thank you for easing my mind--and for helping my sister.

passages.title: Beneath the Roots
passages.text:
I am glad to see you are well, <name>. I have recently received word that a number of the Aeroknights have taken shelter in a camp close to where the airship was seized in mid-air. 

Would you check on them?

passages.title: Beneath the Roots
passages.text: We are doing our best with what we have. The owners of this camp have allowed us sanctuary, but there are no smiles here.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Dread Pit
passages.text:
Two things are bad for business. Earnest competition and the Dread Pit caves. We need someone to deal with the latter!

Something bad is going on here. We lost a bunch of workers in this cave.

We need you to deal with the threat, so we can keep business booming!

passages.title: Delver's Call: Dread Pit
passages.text: Glad I finally found someone to check out the Dread Pit!

passages.title: Delver's Call: Dread Pit
passages.text:
You took care of them spiders in the Dread Pit? Great!

I'll get to work on figuring out a better name for that place. "Dread Pit" just ain't catchy enough.

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Sinkhole
passages.text:
We have reports of large amounts of kobyss gathering towards a lair called the Sinkhole. There are concerns they plan to attack the smaller coast villages when they get the chance.

There's a hefty reward for anyone who can go into the Sinkhole and stop whatever they're planning!

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Sinkhole
passages.text: Beware of what lurks within the Sinkhole.

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Sinkhole
passages.text:
Thank you for the aid. It's hard to aid everyone in Hallowfall given the current situation.

Hopefully, the kobyss will think twice about trying any further attacks.

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Skittering Breach
passages.text:
Call For Any Who Can Swing a Sword or Sling a Spell!

The nerubians perform foul rituals in the shadow of our once beautiful Aegis Wall. Word is that a dark temple dedicated to their cursed gods rests beneath the ground. 

Someone must investigate this foul place and put an end to their schemes.

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Skittering Breach
passages.text: The Skittering Breach is a dangerous place. Be on your guard if you're going in.

passages.title: Delver's Call: The Skittering Breach
passages.text:
You survived the Skittering Breach? I know many a Lamplighter who was forced to retreat from that foul place.

You've made this land safer. Thank you.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Mycomancer Cavern
passages.text:
Spice Help Needed!

Fungarians in the Mycomancer Caverns have been raiding spice crates bound for Lorel's Crossing. Someone needs to go into those caverns and push back the fungarian menace! 

Will pay well.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Mycomancer Cavern
passages.text: I heard the fungarians had been thinned out by someone recently. Thank you!

passages.title: Delver's Call: Spiral Weave
passages.text:
A lot of us survivors have heard stories about the Spiral Weave. Seems like it's a place where the nerubians have some heavy military operations going on.

Taking the fight to them would help put a serious dent in the nerubians' war plans.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Spiral Weave
passages.text: You're going into the heart of a nerubian military base. Be careful.

passages.title: Delver's Call: Spiral Weave
passages.text: You did it! That should give our forces on the surface a bit of a reprieve.

passages.title: Witnessing Brilliance
passages.text:
The time has finally come and the moment could not be more exhilarating. It's time to get to work.

Join me outside, let's observe the fruits of our labor.

passages.title: Witnessing Brilliance
passages.text: Well... that certainly did not go as planned.

passages.title: Something on the Horizon
passages.text:
Brann's scouts have reported sightings of reinforcements approaching the shores of Khaz Algar.

He's put out the call for adventurers to join him in Dornogal.

passages.title: Something on the Horizon
passages.text: I've 'eard reports o' reinforcements approaching the isle. Ye know Khaz Algar inside and out--they'll need yer expertise.

passages.title: A Time to Come Together
passages.text:
We ought tae be getting a whole fleet o' reinforcements soon. Just in time, I hear Alleria and Anduin are back in Dornogal.

If I know Moira, she'll already be workin' with 'em tae figure out our next move. She knows how tae lead like a gryphon knows how tae fly. Best go find her before she comes looking for ye.

passages.title: A Time to Come Together
passages.text: Perfect timing. I've got good news for the first time since we crashed here.

passages.title: Hungry in Hollow
passages.text:
Hey. You looking for a great meal?

Willing to wade through the mud to get it?

Go see Dolena. She'll sort you out. Don't bother trying to convince her to leave that hollow, though. Believe me--we've all tried. Why someone would leave the safety of the light for that...

She seems to do alright, though.

passages.title: Hungry in Hollow
passages.text: Ah, another one. You here on purpose?

passages.title: Renown of Khaz Algar
passages.text:
There is still much we still need tae do to aid Khaz Algar.

But I dunnae know much about this land past the realms of earthen.

I'll have to refer ye to Faerin Lothar tae see what Hallowfall may need.

Talk to her an' see if she needs any help. Ye already are acquainted, aren't ye?

passages.title: Renown of Khaz Algar
passages.text:
Good to see you again, <name>. 

We have a lot of work to do.

passages.title: Making the Underworld Go Round
passages.text:
Hey there, 'Overcrawler.' You're lookin' more than a little out of your element there. You get run over by an airship or something?

Whatever. Doesn't matter. Take it from one outsider to another, if you're going to survive down here you're gonna need to learn the rules of the road. Gold's all well and good where you came from, but down here you're gonna need Kej, and lots of it.

Now here. Consider this a token of good will from Lady Pedipalps up there. Go get yourself something nice.

passages.title: Making the Underworld Go Round
passages.text: What, you allergic to retail therapy or something? Get out there and live a little!

passages.title: Making the Underworld Go Round
passages.text:
Get a good look around? This place is pretty spooky, even for a savvy gal like me. But get enough Kej together and you'll be able to buy all sorts of stuff, both here and in the City of Threads.

<Linny looks you up and down.>

Then again, you're probably still gonna get eaten, so maybe look into fine nerubian gravestones.

passages.title: Of Pacts and Patrons
passages.text:
The Severed Threads is ready for you and your allies. You will be a lit torch to Ansurek's webs.

The General, the Vizier, and, myself, the Weaver, each have differing methods of combating our foes... and different benefits of aiding our accomplices. You may prefer to prioritize one, or perhaps to dabble with all three instead.

Meet with our representatives, and inform yourself on our varying practices. Then you may forge your first Pact.

Don't worry, little morsel, no choice is ever permanent.

passages.title: Of Pacts and Patrons
passages.text: Have you considered your options?

passages.title: Of Pacts and Patrons
passages.text: May your chosen patron favor you, as you have them.

passages.title: Stormrider's Honors
passages.text:
<A golden missive finds its way to you.>

Champion, though you are no Stormrider, you may yet be worthy of the Stormrider's armor.

Find Stormrider Bruelda if you wish to claim this honor.

passages.title: Stormrider's Honors
passages.text: What is it?

passages.title: Seeking Knowledge of the Past
passages.text:
Greetings, <race>. I must seek your aid. Soridormi and our kin have journeyed to Khaz Algar to help in this fight against the Void's new master.

We think that we can provide insight and valuable information about past attacks by the Void. 

Seek her out near the southern edge of the Coreway.

passages.title: Seeking Knowledge of the Past
passages.text: You are just in time as always! Let us speak of what brings me here.

passages.title: The Blooming Lattice
passages.text:
You're that stranger I've been hearing about, aren't you? I'm Su'meera, apprentice painter to Ja'kul. You heard of him? No? Maybe his work hasn't made it to your lands. That makes sense, I guess.

Anyhow, I heard you like helping people out. Well, a few important things went missing when Ja'kul was attacked and killed. I want them back.

Will you meet me near Blooming Lattice?

passages.title: The Blooming Lattice
passages.text:
Thanks for coming. I wasn't sure you would. Up the hill that way is Blooming Lattice--a settlement of rutaani who are quite vicious.

Their leaders killed Ja'kul, and took his things. I want them back!

passages.title: Supplicants to the Goddess
passages.text:
We have long tended to the roots with the help of the creatures who live and grow here. Think of it as a symbiotic relationship from which we, the creatures, and the roots all benefit. That said, my partner Riverscale isn't contributing very much lately!

Please help me find a way to motivate him again.

First, you must cleanse off the essence of the outside. Cleanse yourself in the waters of Har'kuai.

passages.title: Supplicants to the Goddess
passages.text: This may seem inconsequential, but it's all a part of the process.

passages.title: Midnight: World Tour
passages.text:
The immediate danger has passed, but there is still much to be done.

Go out and work with our allies to secure what ground we have made against the darkness. Whether it is in Azeroth or beyond, there is still much to be done.

passages.title: Midnight: World Tour
passages.text: Back so soon? Impressive!

passages.title: New Tools, New Heights
passages.text:
There is another sort of Void power I know you will be interested in. An Ascendant Voidcore is difficult to come by, and even more difficult to work. With the Voidforge completed, I can now weave a magnificent Nilhammer capable of such things. Of course, I will need you to help with the materials. It will take time.

Take this chunk of Hungering Oblivium. It can devour moments of extreme violence to be catalyzed to new heights of power, but I don't think you'll have any trouble managing that, will you?

passages.title: New Tools, New Heights
passages.text: Have you fed your pet rock yet, <name>? I would not suggest leaving Oblivium on your person for extended periods of time...

passages.title: New Tools, New Heights
passages.text: I can feel the Hungering Oblivium radiating power! Well done, <name>. We have taken the first step towards even greater power. It will take me some time to prepare more Oblivium to continue our work here.

passages.title: The Last Push
passages.text:
Our forces are starting to move out to take the fight to Xal'atath. 

I've received word there are many areas that you've visited that could still use some aid. 

We must focus our attention on the counter offensive. Can you help those that are in need?

passages.title: The Last Push
passages.text: There's plenty out there that can be done.

passages.title: The Last Push
passages.text:
Fine work <name>. 

There's plenty to do now that you've taken care of those issues.

passages.title: The War Beyond the Roots
passages.text:
Your actions in Harandar caused quite an uproar. The elders are up in arms. The rootwardens are worried. It's really quite exhausting.

But there is good news as well. Orweyna has heard rumblings from every corner of the roots. She tells me of haranir who wish to see the world as she does--who feel compelled to seek the goddess beyond the boughs of Harandar.

I will handle things in Harandar. Go to your leaders. Tell them that the haranir are ready to join the fight.

passages.title: The War Beyond the Roots
passages.text:
The haranir seek to join the fight against the Void?

Far be it from me to look a gift hawkstrider in the mouth. Halduron has vouched for both their strength and their tenacity. We shall need a great deal of both, in the battles to come.

passages.title: Frenzied Fossicking
passages.text:
Ya be down for helping me out with a little spot of bother?
